title: Life in the Future
text:
In the future, many people will use robots at home. A robot can clean the floor and cook simple meals. Some cars will drive themselves on the roads. These cars will help people travel safely.

Doctors may also use new machines. A small machine can check your heart from your phone. Scientists think these tools will make life easier. However, some people worry about their privacy.

questions.text: What can a home robot do?
options: Clean the floor and cook simple meals

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can a small machine do?
options: Check your heart from your phone

questions.text: Why do some people worry about the new technology?
options: They think it is too cheap
They do not like the colour of robots

questions.text: What is the writer's attitude toward future technology?

vocabulary.definition: machines that can do tasks automatically
people who study and research how the world works
the right to keep personal information private

paragraph_translations: En el futuro, muchas personas usarán robots en casa. Un robot puede limpiar el suelo y cocinar comidas sencillas. Algunos coches se conducirán solos por las carreteras. Estos coches ayudarán a las personas a viajar con seguridad.

Los médicos también podrían usar máquinas nuevas. Una máquina pequeña puede revisar tu corazón desde tu teléfono. Los científicos piensan que estas herramientas harán la vida más fácil. Sin embargo, algunas personas se preocupan por su privacidad.
